extensionDescription.message: Automatically select and maintain your preferred YouTube quality.

enhancedHint.message: Preferred when available for your Premium account.

fixedHint.message: Falls back to the nearest lower quality.

saveError.message: Could not save. Please try changing the setting again.

loadError.message: Could not load settings. Please reopen the popup.

importInvalid.message: This is not a valid FrameFix settings file.

importVersion.message: This settings file version is not supported.

importTooLarge.message: Settings files must be 64 KB or smaller.

disabledHint.message: Quality control is off. YouTube chooses automatically.

maxVolumeHint.message: You can adjust volume afterward. Muted playback stays muted.
